-- web/web.go --
package web

import (
	fabrikweb "github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/web"
)

//fabrik:web GET /login
func Login(req *fabrikweb.Request) (fabrikweb.Response, error) {
	return fabrikweb.Template("auth/password/login", nil), nil
}
-- want/main.gen.go --
// Code generated by fabrik. DO NOT EDIT.
// Regenerate with: fabrik wire

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/router"
	web2 "github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/web"

	"app/authmagic"
	"app/authpassword"
	"app/shared"
	"app/web"
)

func run() int {
	if err := func() (err error) {
		// Providers
		r := router.New()
		requestFuncs := web2.DefaultRequestFuncs()
		appTemplates, err := web2.LoadTemplateSources([]web2.TemplateSource{
			{FS: authmagic.Templates, Dir: "templates"},
			{FS: authpassword.Templates, Dir: "templates"},
			{FS: shared.Templates, Dir: "templates"},
		}, requestFuncs.Stubs())
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		adapter := web2.NewAdapter(web2.WithRenderer(appTemplates), web2.WithRequestFuncs(requestFuncs))

		// Register
		r.Method("GET", "/login", adapter.Wrap(web.Login))
		return nil
	}(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "app:", err)
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}
